note: Settings of the Civil 3D probe round (R150 to R159). Every ROSHN file name, layer name and surface name the c3d_*.py files use sits here. accoreconsole is the core console of Civil 3D 2026 and product the switch that loads Civil 3D in it. probeDll is the .NET 8 build of dotnet/SiteAdaptation.C3DProbe/Civil, relative to the repo root. sourceRoot holds the real drawings, folders names the folders copied into probeRoot/work with their layout kept, so xrefs resolve. Nothing is ever written under sourceRoot. probeRoot holds work, out and logs, outside the repo. drawings gives each drawing of the round a short role and its path under work. timeoutSeconds is how long one core console run may take before the runner stops the process it started. survey holds what python/c3d_drawings.py looks for in the ACadSharp output of each copy (R154): levelWords are words that mark a level text, levelRange the band a bare number must fall in to look like a level, levelDecimals the least decimals it must have, and lineRoles the layer patterns, matched without case, of the lines that may be a curb, an edge of road, a back of sidewalk, a right of way, a building line or a setback. connect holds what python/c3d_connect.py reads to tie the drawings to the plots (R156 to R158). baseplanPlots and landxmlDir are earlier reader outputs on this machine, plan and prototypes the answer key of the past job. curb names the drawing role and layers of the curb lines the plot front is taken from. lines names the other line sets to measure, and backOfSidewalk which of them stands for the back of the sidewalk. searchM is how far a surface edge is looked for, textRadiusM and lineRadiusM how near a level text or a 3D line must be to give a level. bandsM are the 5 mm and 30 mm bands. neighbourhoods names the schedule and plot number shift of each neighbourhood, null where none is on this machine. unitPlotTypes are the baseplan types that carry a unit. cutPlots are the plots whose cut is checked against the footprint blocks of cutDrawing, cutLabels the baseplan labels and types of that cut. snapM is how far outside its last triangle a point may lie and still take the level of the nearest surface edge (R157). surfacePair are the two surfaces whose overlap python/c3d_surfaces.py samples on a grid of overlapStepM (R155). checkSurface is the surface whose snapped level python/c3d_check.py recomputes by brute force (R159). dataBook holds round DATA (R160 to R168): root is the data book outside the repo with its own work copies of folders, drawings gives each drawing a role and its path under work, border names the drawing, layer and label of the Phase 1 border (R163), acad and watcher are the full Civil 3D window and the dialog watcher of R161, minFreeGB stops a run when free memory falls under it, timeoutMinutes ends a run that takes longer, knownSurfaces are the surfaces of the existing LandXML that are not exported again, unless exportKnownSurfaces is true, then the full window exports every surface (R169), roadSurfaceOrder is the order surfaces are asked for the plot front level (R166), excel is the master plan workbook, schedules and coordinate PDFs come from the earlier readers. dataBook.join names what python/data_book.py joins per plot (R166): fallbackOutputs are earlier CadReader outputs used where a data book table holds no geometry, cutsheet the frame and number layers, footprint the drawing and the setback layer, curb and row the line layers, v9 the plot number text layer, masterBlocks the drawings whose blocks are read per plot, unitsRev6 the unit count of Rev 6 the plot count is compared with. dataBook.retest holds round DATA-2 (R170 to R173): steepUnits are the Rev 6 units the by typology test gives the steepest front slope of the profile, unitBlockKinds the first word of a footprint unit block name, unitShareMin the share of a block outline a face must hold to carry one of its units, setbackLinesM the drawn setback distances the second method classes by, check the seeds, sample size, least front edge and length slack of python/data_book_retest_check.py, phase1Sheet the rows and columns of the Phase1 sheet the units are compared with, unitsRev6ByCode the Rev 6 count by unit code. dataBook.analysis holds what python/data_book_analysis.py compares with (R167): the plot widths of Rev 6 by client plot type, widthFromCad the client types whose width comes from CAD and is no conflict (VL4, Bader in round DATA-2), the setback of Rev 6 (5.52 m, C10 5.50 m) with their tolerances, the client types that carry a unit, the neighbourhood codes searched in every text and the level bands.
